messages:
Elena C: Midweek spend pulse for account 'Orchid' — noticed a few micro-bursts on the hosted API that pushed usage slightly above their commit. Quick dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/accounts/orchid :eyes:
Sam K: Saw that too. Two spikes around 01:12 and 03:08 UTC, dev keys were the top callers. Net over-commit ~12% across 48h.
Jayden R: I pulled logs — lots of short requests with repeated retries, many 502s from upstream. Could be an SDK retry loop.
billing-bot: ALERT: orchid exceeded hosted commit threshold (10%) — flag: anomaly_high_burn — issued 1717000020.
Maya (CE): I'll reach out to the customer docs team, ask if they ran any automated load tests or CI jobs. Will update within 2 hours.
Elena C: Thanks. Hypothesis: staging/test harness accidentally targeting prod keys. If true, we can ask them to rotate keys and run tests against staging.
Sam K: Ops-side mitigation: we can set a temporary soft cap and route extra requests to a degraded tier while we confirm. Want to avoid hard cut for renewals.
Jayden R: Running query now: `SELECT client_id, count(*) AS calls FROM requests WHERE account='orchid' AND ts > now() - interval '48 hours' GROUP BY client_id ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 10;` — will paste top clients in ~10m.
Elena C: Good. Also looking at latency: the bursts correlate with slightly higher p95 (by ~30ms) but error rate spike is mostly 502/504. Not a platform-wide incident.
Maya (CE): Reached out to customer via shared thread — asked them to confirm CI targets and to provide recent API key names.
Sam K: If it's prod-key noise, recommend applying `soft_quota=commit * 1.05` and extra requests get 429 with informative body linking to support. We can revert when they confirm.
Jayden R: Query results: top client_id `orchid-ci-3` = 48k calls, next `orchid-web-1` = 9k. `orchid-ci-3` timestamps cluster every 30s. Looks like a cron.
Elena C: That's our smoking gun. Maya — ask them to pause that job or switch key. Also set a temporary alert to watch for new spikes.
Maya (CE): On it. I asked them to pause and sent a sample curl to validate staging endpoint.
billing-bot: NOTE: Watchlisted accounts updated: orchid -> reviewer: elena.c, severity: elevated.
Sam K: I'll draft a temporary soft-quota change and post the config diff in #eng-ops for a quick apply.
Elena C: Next steps: (1) Maya confirm customer paused CI (2) Jayden confirm no other noisy clients (3) Sam apply soft cap if they don't pause in 30m (4) I'll propose commit uplift options if this is planned CI usage.
Maya (CE): Customer confirmed — paused. They had a misconfigured scheduler.
Jayden R: No other noisy clients. Top client normalized after pause.
Sam K: Rolling back proposed soft cap. Leaving an annotation in billing for this week's commit reconciliation.
Elena C: Great — close the loop in the AM health summary and record the incident as a spend-flutter (low severity) for renewal notes.
Maya (CE): Will update the onboarding checklist to remind customers to run CI against staging keys. :memo:
Elena C: Thanks all. Marking as resolved unless anything else pops up. :shipit:
